_what: Versioned freeze of the nflverse HISTORICAL raw (2013-2025) that the warehouse build reads. Hermetic ONLY IF every file named here exists (asserted at build start by transform.warehouse.assert_frozen_files_exist): _cached_nflverse reads the historical cache; teams_lookup feeds dim_team.

teams_lookup._what: nfl.load_teams() static team lookup for dim_team (transform/warehouse.py:322-329). Was MISSING for phases 3-9, so every warehouse build made a LIVE nfl.load_teams() network call -- the 'network-free after caching' claim was UNVERIFIED and FALSE. Frozen 2026-07-30.
teams_lookup.note_rows: 36 rows (incl. historical/relocated abbrevs), NOT the '32' the prior waiver stated.
teams_lookup.VINTAGE_MISMATCH: fetched 2026-07-30 = ONE DAY LATER than the 2013-2025 raw vintage 2026-07-29. Teams data is static so content is near-certainly identical to a 2026-07-29 fetch, but this is a later fetch and is recorded explicitly, NOT absorbed into the 2026-07-29 vintage.

bump_procedure: 1. Re-pull historical raw:  VIGIL_UNFREEZE=1 uv run python -m ingest.nflverse --force
2. Rebuild + capture input hashes:  uv run python -m jobs.refresh --mode full --only warehouse,metrics
3. Re-run reproducibility:  uv run python -m tests.test_reproducibility  AND  uv run python -m jobs.repro_check
4. If artifacts changed, that is an UPSTREAM REVISION (escalate, re-baseline drift_baseline.json), not drift.
5. Update this vintage + input_signature and commit.
learning_about_upstream_corrections: Because the build no longer sees live nflverse, upstream corrections are invisible by design. A separate MONTHLY manual probe (bump step 1 into a temp, diff input hashes) surfaces them; a diff triggers a deliberate, reviewed re-baseline rather than silent drift.
